content_text:
Moderator
Hello everyone,
Earlier this month, we released an episode of the Team Deakins Podcast featuring production sound mixer Simon Hayes. Simon has worked on a number of musicals (most recently WICKED) and films of other genres, from SHAUN OF THE DEAD to LOCK, STOCK AND TWO SMOKING BARRELS.
Feel free to discuss the episode with each other below!
